import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def model(p):
    return (p[0]*eps*T + p[1]*T**3 + p[2]*eps**2*T**2*np.exp(p[3]*eps/T)
            + p[4]*eps/T + p[5]*eps**2*np.exp(p[6]*eps)/T + p[7]*eps**2 + p[8]*eps**3*T**3 + p[9]*eps**2*T)
best=None
for trial in range(5):
    p0=np.random.RandomState(trial).randn(10)*0.5
    r=least_squares(lambda p: (model(p)-sigma)/np.std(sigma), p0, method='lm', max_nfev=20000)
    v=np.mean((model(r.x)-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma)
    if best is None or v<best[0]: best=(v,r.x)
print(best[0]); print(np.round(best[1],5))
# drop-one term importance
p=best[1]
for k in range(10):
    q=p.copy(); q[k]=0
    print(k, np.mean((model(q)-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma))
